prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a parking lot collision. The patient had 16 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1105; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: The patient presented after a low-speed collision in a parking lot with a distal radius wrist fracture, and the reported mechanism is consistent with this type of injury. Over the course of 16 visits, treatment followed a typical progression: immobilization, followed by supervised range-of-motion exercises and graduated strengthening, with visit frequency tapering as function returned. Examination findings at intake and in later visits show tenderness and reduced grip strength over the fracture site that support the diagnosis, while several other neurological and vascular tests were within normal limits. No prior injury to the same wrist or forearm is documented in the available history. The billing record shows two similar charges entered on the same day, which are currently under review for accuracy. At discharge the patient had regained most functional range and was released to independent home exercise.
